statement: Fresh macro pilot: retain eta=0.001, alpha=20, reflecting domain and adaptive CFL=0.4; evolve 256^2 through t=0.81 with output every 0.05. Prospectively select first output at or after t=0.8 and the origin-centered coalescence sheet, prior to any kinetic evidence. Measure actual reversal width and test macro refinement before qualification. Source/patch scale will be set from that measurement, not anisotropy.
